name: River Flood
description: The river bursts its banks across its floodplains: improvements there may be damaged, but the silt leaves +1 food behind.

name: Great Storm
description: A storm off the sea batters the coast: improvements may be damaged and units caught in it are hurt.

name: Dust Storm
description: A dust storm sweeps the desert: improvements may be damaged, but the dust it drops leaves +1 production.

name: Drought
description: A dry year away from the rivers: settlements it reaches lose half their stored food.

name: Volcanic Eruption
description: A volcano erupts: everything around it is damaged and nearby settlements lose a citizen, but the ash leaves +1 food and +1 production.
